description: Move Jordan Rivera's Friday cleaning to Monday with a dental office front desk, against three callees: cooperative, an insurance question plus an odd slot time, and an early interruption; plus a diagnostic callee who speaks the instant the line opens. These are plain two-party calls (no IVR declared); the phone menu lives in dental-menu.json.

brief.persona: I am Ava, calling on behalf of Jordan Rivera, Jordan's personal assistant.
brief.objective: Reschedule Jordan Rivera's dental cleaning, currently Friday at 3pm with Dr. Nguyen, to a time on Monday next week.
facts: The existing appointment is a cleaning on Friday at 3pm with Dr. Nguyen.
Jordan Rivera's dental insurance is Alta Dental, and it has not changed.
Jordan Rivera's date of birth is March 4, 1988.
preferences: Jordan Rivera can do any time on Monday next week.
Jordan Rivera would rather keep Dr. Nguyen, but another dentist is acceptable for a cleaning.

authorizedCommitments: Move the cleaning to any time on Monday next week.

fields.name: newAppointment
fields.description: Day and time of the rescheduled cleaning, or empty if nothing was agreed

fields.name: confirmedBy
fields.description: Name of the person at the office who confirmed the change

personas.name: cooperative
personas.role: Sam, the front-desk scheduler at Bayside Dental
facts: Jordan Rivera has a cleaning on Friday at 3pm with Dr. Nguyen.
Dr. Nguyen has an opening on Monday at 10am.
behaviours: Answer with "Bayside Dental, this is Sam."
Look up the appointment and offer "Monday at 10am with Dr. Nguyen".
When the caller accepts, confirm it: "Okay, you're all set for Monday at 10."
personas.endsCallWith: Okay, you're all set for Monday at 10.

personas.name: insurance-and-odd-time
personas.role: Sam, the front-desk scheduler at Bayside Dental
facts: Jordan Rivera has a cleaning on Friday at 3pm with Dr. Nguyen.
Dr. Nguyen's only Monday opening is at 9:26.
behaviours: Answer with "Bayside Dental, this is Sam."
Before offering anything, ask: "do you know if he's still with Alta Dental?"
Then offer "Monday at 9:26" and nothing else.
When the caller accepts, confirm it with "Mm-hmm, Monday 9:26".

personas.name: interrupter
personas.role: Sam, the front-desk scheduler at Bayside Dental
facts: Jordan Rivera has a cleaning on Friday at 3pm with Dr. Nguyen.
Dr. Nguyen has an opening on Monday at 2:30pm.
behaviours: Answer with "Bayside Dental, this is Sam."
Cut in while the caller is still giving their first explanation, before they finish, with "Sorry — which doctor was that?"
Once you hear the answer, offer "Monday at 2:30 with Dr. Nguyen".
When the caller accepts, confirm it: "Great, Monday at 2:30 it is."

personas.name: instant-hello
personas.role: Sam, the front-desk scheduler at Bayside Dental
facts: Jordan Rivera has a cleaning on Friday at 3pm with Dr. Nguyen.
Dr. Nguyen has an opening on Monday at 10am.
behaviours: Answer with "Bayside Dental, this is Sam."
Look up the appointment and offer "Monday at 10am with Dr. Nguyen".
When the caller accepts, confirm it: "Okay, you're all set for Monday at 10."
personas.endsCallWith: Okay, you're all set for Monday at 10.
